derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding, all classes (911,472 ÷ (544,546,000 + 59,976,000))

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page (shares in thousands)
inputs.quote: As of October 30, 2026, the number of shares (in thousands) of the registrant's Class A and Class B common stock outstanding were 544,546 and 59,976 , respectively.

inputs.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, share class rights
inputs.quote: The holders of our Class A and Class B common stock (together, "common stock") have identical liquidation and dividend rights but different voting rights.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of February 20, 2026, there we re 442 holders of record of our Class A common stock and 22 holders of record of our Class B common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026; Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds Class A; the denominator is Class A plus Class B from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (counts in thousands, at October 30, 2026), the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 22 holders of record of Class B (the 10-K text reads 'there we re', reproduced as printed).
